programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生。明天与母亲、舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结。明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪。鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋。

programme.title: 使徒行者3 第27集
programme.desc: 薛家强(林峯饰)完成三年卧底任务后，回港开设沐足店，继续收集情报。刑事情报科总督察章纪孜(黄智雯饰)怀疑卓凯(苗侨伟饰)出狱后投入黑道，对他进行全面监视。家强与卓凯卷入器官贩卖案，联同女卧底窦亚希(蔡思贝饰)及保安局调查官韦作荣(马国明饰)，合力捣破涉案集团。保安局及后新设安全情报机构，并邀得徐天堂(袁伟豪饰)加入，接管刑事情报科的工作。覃欢喜(许绍雄饰)逃过一死后，暗中调查某社团的秘密。神秘社团原来由长兴已故龙头魏德信的弟弟魏德礼创立，他还设下布局，对家强、卓凯等展开报复……

programme.title: 碧血盐枭 第17集
programme.desc: 缉私营的聂致远(马浚伟)为剿灭盐枭窦家寨，故意扮作落难秀才博取盐枭之女窦胜雪(杨怡)的同情及收留，因而与窦胜雪建立了深厚的感情。某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混乱之中窦胜雪身受重伤并与聂致远及家人失散，幸得盐商胡坚(郭峰)之子胡亭轩(黄浩然)相救，并暂留胡府待找回双亲及聂致远，但窦胜雪却惊见父母的尸首被悬于城楼示众，而站在楼顶大义凛然地告诫众人不要贩卖私盐的官员，竟是令自己日夜牵肠挂肚的聂致远，窦胜雪柔肠寸断，且对聂致远有彻骨之恨...

programme.title: 解决师 第1集
programme.desc: 「解决师」协助黑帮解决终极难题，往往无所不用其极！澳洲华人黑帮解决师Karson(王浩信饰)，欲远离黑道与挚爱Chloe(张曦雯饰)一起，可惜Chole意外死亡。K同时遭嫁祸杀害黑帮龙头，以假死逃避追杀，到了香港成为中学体育老师O Sir敖熙辰，展开第二人生。5E班新任班主任Jovy蒋颖欣(唐诗咏饰)，实为黑帮龙头千金，父亲金盆洗手令黑白两道掀起巨浪，且殃及校园，O Sir逼不得已再以解决师身份，肩负保护Jovy及学生的使命。警队明日之星Man Sir文浩全(张颕康饰)，矢志铲除全港黑势力，一个真相令他的道德观彻底崩溃，一念之间踏上成魔之路，下属Ace(冯盈盈饰)深爱Man Sir，却欲劝无从……O Sir得悉Chloe之死另有阴谋，同时Jovy父亲被暗杀，Jovy在亡父得力助手项颂如(陈敏之饰)的帮助下，接管龙头之位，以制衡江湖乱局。 O Sir正与Jovy相爱，当然倾力襄助并严加保护。此时，面对正邪世界重新定位，谁能将黑白颠倒拨乱反正？

programme.title: 丫鬟大联盟 第10集
programme.desc: 以兵部侍郎裘府丫鬟月盈(黄心颖饰)为首的六部丫鬟组成联盟，互通消息，一起赚钱。月皎(汤洛雯饰)为筹钱给爱郎傅有为(谢东闵饰)上京赴考，卖身为婢。月盈与月皎分别服侍大夫人官之姵(郭少芸饰)和二夫人上官云英(张慧仪饰)，各为其主，互相斗法！少爷裘其进(洪永城饰)与月盈情投意合，可惜遭父裘正(郑子诚饰)打压。裘正犯事被降职，其进决心考取功名，重振家声。兵部尚书霍奔(潘志文饰)之女霍燕贞(刘思希饰)也看上有为，多番引诱。月盈、月皎害怕情郎高中后失去对方，誓要他们状元梦碎。两对恋人面临决裂之际，竟卷入卖国漩涡中……

programme.title: 他来自江湖 第13集
programme.desc: 明天原是黑道枭雄，因一次买卖令未婚妻意外身亡而大受打击，决洗心革面，经营联谊会为生。明天与母亲、舅父何英彪及表弟何鑫淼同住，英彪一直怀疑明天当年连累他被革离警队，故对他诸多单打，但明天并不介怀，鑫淼却视明天为偶像，两人情同手足，使英彪为之气结。明天自未婚妻死后，本心如止水，不料邂逅余文骞及阮黛玉，感情生活泛起涟漪。鑫淼为父误入歧途，牵涉入毒品买卖，明天为救鑫淼，联同警务督察旧友马世雄，与黑帮周旋。

programme.title: 使徒行者3 第28集
programme.desc: 薛家强(林峯饰)完成三年卧底任务后，回港开设沐足店，继续收集情报。刑事情报科总督察章纪孜(黄智雯饰)怀疑卓凯(苗侨伟饰)出狱后投入黑道，对他进行全面监视。家强与卓凯卷入器官贩卖案，联同女卧底窦亚希(蔡思贝饰)及保安局调查官韦作荣(马国明饰)，合力捣破涉案集团。保安局及后新设安全情报机构，并邀得徐天堂(袁伟豪饰)加入，接管刑事情报科的工作。覃欢喜(许绍雄饰)逃过一死后，暗中调查某社团的秘密。神秘社团原来由长兴已故龙头魏德信的弟弟魏德礼创立，他还设下布局，对家强、卓凯等展开报复……

programme.title: 碧血盐枭 第18集
programme.desc: 缉私营的聂致远(马浚伟)为剿灭盐枭窦家寨，故意扮作落难秀才博取盐枭之女窦胜雪(杨怡)的同情及收留，因而与窦胜雪建立了深厚的感情。某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混乱之中窦胜雪身受重伤并与聂致远及家人失散，幸得盐商胡坚(郭峰)之子胡亭轩(黄浩然)相救，并暂留胡府待找回双亲及聂致远，但窦胜雪却惊见父母的尸首被悬于城楼示众，而站在楼顶大义凛然地告诫众人不要贩卖私盐的官员，竟是令自己日夜牵肠挂肚的聂致远，窦胜雪柔肠寸断，且对聂致远有彻骨之恨...

programme.desc: 缉私营的聂致远(马浚伟)为剿灭盐枭窦家寨，故意扮作落难秀才博取盐枭之女窦胜雪(杨怡)的同情及收留，因而与窦胜雪建立了深厚的感情。某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混乱之中窦胜雪身受重伤并与聂致远及家人失散，幸得盐商胡坚(郭峰)之子胡亭轩(黄浩然)相救，并暂留胡府待找回双亲及聂致远，但窦胜雪却惊见父母的尸首被悬于城楼示众，而站在楼顶大义凛然地告诫众人不要贩卖私盐的官员，竟是令自己日夜牵肠挂肚的聂致远，窦胜雪柔肠寸断，且对聂致远有彻骨之恨...

programme.title: 解决师 第5集
programme.desc: 「解决师」协助黑帮解决终极难题，往往无所不用其极！澳洲华人黑帮解决师Karson(王浩信饰)，欲远离黑道与挚爱Chloe(张曦雯饰)一起，可惜Chole意外死亡。K同时遭嫁祸杀害黑帮龙头，以假死逃避追杀，到了香港成为中学体育老师O Sir敖熙辰，展开第二人生。5E班新任班主任Jovy蒋颖欣(唐诗咏饰)，实为黑帮龙头千金，父亲金盆洗手令黑白两道掀起巨浪，且殃及校园，O Sir逼不得已再以解决师身份，肩负保护Jovy及学生的使命。警队明日之星Man Sir文浩全(张颕康饰)，矢志铲除全港黑势力，一个真相令他的道德观彻底崩溃，一念之间踏上成魔之路，下属Ace(冯盈盈饰)深爱Man Sir，却欲劝无从……O Sir得悉Chloe之死另有阴谋，同时Jovy父亲被暗杀，Jovy在亡父得力助手项颂如(陈敏之饰)的帮助下，接管龙头之位，以制衡江湖乱局。 O Sir正与Jovy相爱，当然倾力襄助并严加保护。此时，面对正邪世界重新定位，谁能将黑白颠倒拨乱反正？

programme.title: Bloomberg Primer - The Race to Challenge China's EV Lead
programme.desc: Chinese companies dominate the EV battery supply chain and are expanding rapidly outside their home market. Meanwhile, competitors are looking to new chemistries to leapfrog the leading tech.

programme.title: Bloomberg Primer - The Race to Merge AI With Humanoid Robots
programme.desc: Humanoid robots that use AI are going mainstream, but they're far from proven. With billions of dollars invested, can they deliver real-world value or will they fall short of the hype?

programme.title: Bloomberg Primer - AI Is Pushing Chipmaking to Its Limits
programme.desc: Semiconductors power modern technology, from AI to everyday devices. Now, global tensions and rising demand are forcing the chip supply chain to adapt.

programme.title: Bloomberg Primer - The Race to Fuel a Nuclear Energy Comeback
programme.desc: Nuclear power is attempting a comeback, but producing the necessary fuel is complex. From mining to enrichment, can new technologies and supply chains scale to power the next generation of reactors?

programme.title: Bloomberg Primer - The Business of Adapting to Flood Risk
programme.desc: Flooding is rising worldwide, driving a global push for climate adaptation. From tunnels to seawalls to fly farms, can these solutions keep up with accelerating global warming?

programme.desc: AI’s rapid growth is pushing global energy demand skyward, forcing electrical grids to expand and modernize. Now, companies from China to Nigeria are investing in new tech to power the future.

programme.title: Are Bots Killing Online Poker?

programme.title: Quantum Marketing - L'Oréal's Strategy for a New Era of Beauty

programme.title: Quantum Marketing - Airbnb's Bet on Experience-Driven Marketing

programme.title: Frozen Planet S01 - Spring Ep2
programme.desc: Spring brings warmth and life to planet's magical ice worlds. Male adelie penguins arrive in Antarctica to build their nests - it takes a good property to attract the best mates and the males will stop at nothing to better their rivals! A woolly bear caterpillar emerges from the snow having spent the winter frozen solid. Caterpillars normally become moths within months of hatching, but life is so harsh here that the woolly bear takes 14 years to reach adulthood.

programme.title: Evolution S01 - The Bat Ep3
programme.desc: How did the bat get so hungry? Chris Packham sets out to answer a deceptively simple question: how the drive to find food shaped life on Earth and gave rise to one of nature's most insatiable feeders. This is the story of the origin of bums, guts, jaws and super-hearing, and a 500-million-year chain of innovation, survival and hunger.

programme.title: The World's Deadliest Weather S05 - Series 5, Episode 5 Ep5
programme.desc: In the US a man and his dog take cover as a rare tornado outbreak rips through towns on the East coast. In Norway, a boxer has the fight of his life when a swim under the ice goes disastrously wrong and in Western Australia, a homeowner is in a faceoff with the flames.

Is the real threat from the enemy within?

programme.desc: 建城四百年的台南，老味道在传承与创新中延续。传统饼铺、水仙宫鲜鱼汤与百年东菜市，珍藏着代代相传的美食记忆。詹姆士再以现挖绿竹笋水饺变化出三种吃法，赋予经典崭新滋味。

programme.title: 乐游原 第26集
programme.desc: 历经重重波折，李嶷与崔琳终于大婚。岂料洞房花烛夜，一封八百里加急军报骤然送达，两人不得不放下新婚喜悦，再次奔赴战场。

programme.title: 金宵大厦2 第2集

programme.title: 送你一桌味 第2集

programme.title: 二十一天 第12集
programme.desc: 调查逐渐接近核心，幸存者不得不面对自己在绝境中作出的选择。叶萧继续拼凑关键线索，而罗百百货沉降事故背后的秘密，也随着众人的证词一步步接近真相。

programme.title: 乐游原 第28集
programme.desc: 崔琳再度潜入敌营刺探军情，身份险些败露。李嶷率兵前往接应，却不知敌人早已布下更大的陷阱，静待他们自投罗网。

programme.title: 种鬼
programme.desc: 故事描述，计程车司机周通(高飞饰)之妻艾莲(玄智慧饰)红杏出墙，搭上赌场常客方明(徐少强饰)。一日，艾与方争执后独自离去，却被流氓挟往荒屋施暴，艾极力反抗，终堕楼惨死。周受一股神秘力量引导，发现艾尸首，蒙眬间，闻鬼语遣其往找巫师设法报仇。自始怪事接连发生，所有与艾之死有关的人均遭鬼怪缠扰...

programme.title: 曼谷风云
programme.desc: 地下拳手林枫因拒绝替曼谷黑帮打黑拳，因此被追杀。他虽成功逃脱，却失去记忆。当林枫开展其新生活时，却被黑帮发现行踪，并找来绝顶打手对付他。期间林枫忽然回复记忆，并誓要将黑帮歼灭。

programme.title: 白蛇传说
programme.desc: 这部奇幻动作片改编自中国经典传说《白蛇传》，讲述郎中许仙爱上化身为女子的千年白蛇。白蛇的真实身份被揭露后，高僧法海为守护人类与超自然力量之间的平衡，不得不挺身而出，展开一场惊心动魄的对决。

programme.title: 新少林寺
programme.desc: 骄横军阀侯杰在惨遭亲信曹蛮残酷背叛、痛失至爱幼女后，心灰意冷下大彻大悟投身少林隐姓埋名。不料野心勃勃的叛将曹蛮紧随其后引兵屠城，使千年古刹少林危在旦夕。已皈依佛门的侯杰重拾昔日信念，在这场充满血色的因果轮回中，誓以血肉之躯筑起最后的救赎。

programme.title: 龙门飞甲
programme.desc: 本片重拍自1966年经典武侠片《龙门客栈》，当时东厂与西厂宦官掌控朝政，腐败横行。侠客赵怀安与一群刺客联手，秘密铲除宦官势力，维护忠良与国家安定。

programme.title: 青木劫
programme.desc: 民国初年，富甲一方的康氏惨遭灭门，唯一的目击证人—家中的幼女—在亲眼目睹全家被杀后离奇失踪。几十年间，位于青木巷的废弃康宅充斥着灵异惊悚的气氛。随着真相逐渐揭露，这个恐怖的疑团交织着复仇与死亡的动机。

programme.title: 神话
programme.desc: 考古学家杰克因神秘梦境的指引，揭开自己前世身为大将军蒙毅，与异国公主玉漱有一段跨越千年的凄美爱恋。当两人在秦始皇陵天宫重逢之际，为夺取长生秘密的财阀尾随而至。杰克重拾前世战力，与强敌展开一场跨越千年的宿命对决。

programme.title: 师兄撞鬼
programme.desc: 该片描述董骠调查制造毒品案，却惨死在毒贩枪下。董骠化做鬼魂回警察局，借警员周星驰之手查清杀己的凶手。冯淬帆和周星驰在茅山老祖的指导下利用灵药合力斗败邪恶法师，枪毙邓公子，为董骠报了仇，使他能安心上天堂。

programme.title: 无间道III: 终极无间
programme.desc: 2004年，陈永仁被杀后十个月，刘建明被架空职权，只负责琐碎的工作。这时，年轻警司杨锦荣成为警队内的新星，但刘建明推测杨锦荣可能同是黑帮派入警队的卧底﹗决定重新做人的刘建明一方面要置杨锦荣于死地，一方面却要提防自己身份曝光。

programme.title: 爱的世界
programme.desc: 李子良丧妻后，与两个儿子相依为命。妻子的巨额医药费令子良经济十分拮据，受同事教唆往马场孤注一掷，迫得向高利贷借款，从此子良债台高筑，疲于奔命，没有时间与儿子沟通，父子疏离。与此同时高利贷不断登门恐吓，骚扰儿子，最终弄至悲剧发生…

programme.title: 赌侠
programme.desc: 自赌神高进退隐后，其徒刀仔在赌坛崭露头角。然而，盛名之下暗箭难防，各方强敌纷纷觊觎其地位与名号。身陷连场赌局与重重阴谋，刀仔凭藉超群胆识与过人智慧见招拆招，最终在这场巅峰较量中，成功捍卫了赌神之名。

programme.title: 鹿鼎记
programme.desc: 韦小宝被反清复明的“天地会”被派到皇宫当卧底，受命查探四十二章经下落。韦小宝很快成为康熙皇帝的心腹，但他既要执行天地会的任务，最后陷入两难的状态。

programme.title: 法中情
programme.desc: 摄影师田迪文强奸模特儿凌祖儿，幸得大律师叶颖文洗脱控罪。颖文男友高级督察方伟负责此案，不满女友是非不分。祖儿之妹凌珊珊替姐报仇，反遭田施暴，颖文再任其辩护律师。珊珊因过往不良纪录，处处失利，能够令田入罪的机会极微；检控官决定请师兄龙约翰出山相助。

programme.title: 济公
programme.desc: 周星驰饰演天庭中犯下天条的狂妄之神，被派往凡间化身为济公，并立志要感化三个注定沦为「九世乞丐」、「九世妓女」及「九世恶人」之凡人。如济公能于三天内顺利完成此事，他便可重返天庭。

programme.title: 赤脚小子
programme.desc: 穷乡青年关丰曜，终日赤着双脚，以背人过河为活。关父临终前，嘱其出城投靠段青云；段骤见故人之子，留下关在布店当小工。关与私塾女教师华小莲交心，却遭莲父白眼；关为求出人头地，竟往投靠土霸喀和布，结果连累莲父与段相继被喀暗算身亡。关得知真相，惜为时已晚，追悔莫及，决与喀拼过死活...

programme.title: 夜守
programme.desc: 在一次车祸后失忆的王人杰找到夜间警卫的工作。午夜，他准时抵达废弃的大厦上班，却发现三只冤魂如约而至，并揭发了一场复仇计画。究竟这是命运的安排还是邪灵的诅咒？

programme.title: 青蛙王子
programme.desc: 此喜剧在夏威夷开始，富家子为人腼腆，追女乏术，好友充当其爱情顾问，带他四出泡妞，却碰得一鼻子灰，闹出连场笑话。

programme.title: 铁线功夫拳
programme.desc: 武术宗师梁坤为保护心爱的女人毅然退隐江湖，不料他的隐忍却换来了爱人的惨死。意识到宿命避无可避，他重返武林，在丐帮帮主苏灿的鼎力相助下，梁坤杀出一条血路，誓要向那些冷血仇敌讨回血债。

programme.title: 鹿鼎记 II
programme.desc: 「神龙教」教主龙儿奉命协助吴三桂推翻康熙皇帝，却反遭吴三桂陷害，幸得韦小宝相救才得以保命。于是龙儿以身相许，并把绝世武功传于韦小宝以对付吴三桂。最后，韦小宝更意外地从四十二章经中得知满清龙脉的秘密宝藏。

programme.title: 头文字 D
programme.desc: 本片由日本同名殿堂级漫画改编而成。故事描述十八岁的拓海，每天驾驶着父亲残旧的汽车送递豆腐，却无意中练得一手出神入化的飘移技术。拓海被父亲怂恿参加山路赛，竟在众人错愕之下胜出，一夜成名，之后更面对一连串惊险绝伦的挑战赛！

programme.title: 九品芝麻官
programme.desc: 包龙星起初为清朝九品候补知县《九品芝麻官》，号称青天的包拯后裔，却无包拯维护公义的精神，接受地方土豪的贿赂而诬害忠良，以至人人喊打。后来痛改前非，为一名含冤被判处死刑的女子申冤，历尽千辛万苦上燕京告御状，最后被封为八府巡按，在公堂辩论打败恶势力，告大白于天下。

programme.title: 一代宗师
programme.desc: 这部史诗式动作电影是由著名电影人王家卫执导。故事始于佛山，当时年迈的北方功夫宗师宫羽田公开挑战南方宗师叶问。叶问最终胜出，但后来输给宫羽田的女儿宫二，二人却因此结下情缘…

programme.title: 女人心
programme.desc: 有妇之夫孙子威与莉发展婚外情，其妻宝儿忍无可忍，决定离婚。分居后，宝儿认识一群独身但不甘寂寞的女人，经常聚会，各自各精彩！子威后来发觉自己最爱的依然是宝儿，二人决定复合。怎料在庆祝复合的晚会上，二人经过一场争吵，竟宣布第二度离异...

programme.title: 赌城大亨之新哥传奇
programme.desc: 取材自澳门赌王何鸿燊的真人真事，讲述由1930至1960年代赌王努力打拼至事业高峰的故事。1941年日本入侵香港，年青大学生贺新逃离香港奔赴澳门。贺新起初在码头做苦力，凭着他的胆色过人、刻苦耐劳和聪明机智，最终登上澳门博彩业的第一把交椅。

programme.title: 无敌幸运星
programme.desc: 富翁死前立下遗嘱，把财富全留给女儿飞飞，逼使其子秋少及侄儿大傻设法分一杯羹。大傻派小混混幸运星往偷遗嘱，欲在遗嘱上做手脚，而秋少亦找来貌似其妹的阿凤假扮飞飞骗取遗嘱。幸运星打算骗”假飞飞”结婚以夺取遗产，不料二人日久生情，最终幸运星在婚礼日揭发二人的诡计。

programme.title: 青蛇：前缘
programme.desc: 千年前，青蛇在道清的点化下逐渐开化，生出与道清相守之心。因自己对道清的执念，却导致道清进入轮回之劫，遭受世间横死之难。为了化解道清的劫难，数百年间，青蛇不断寻找转世的道清…

programme.title: 珠光宝气
programme.desc: 一名商人的私生女，无意中擦出神仙阿宝，并得到三个愿望。可惜阿宝法术不精，而发生了很多啼笑皆非的事。

programme.title: 柠檬可乐
programme.desc: 就读女校高中的婷婷，因排演《罗密欧与茱丽叶》而与邻校男生Jackson戏假情真，爱情就在排练时萌芽。这是婷婷的初恋，但Jaskson却是一个变幻莫测的爱情玩家…

programme.title: 回魂夜
programme.desc: 老妇神秘堕楼死亡，鬼魂于回魂夜当晚出现作祟。弄得一众大厦保安员不得安宁，并邀请了捉鬼大师Leo与女助手相助。Leo从老妇鬼魂得知，她是被儿子及媳妇所杀害，为了让老妇安息，Leo答应将夫妇二人绳之以法...

programme.title: 虚拟特攻
programme.desc: 金牌保镖龙威在妻子惨死后患上了创伤后应激障碍，心情低落。他意外结识高科技公司职员Amy，在她邀请下参加了新产品的虚拟测试。龙威测试成功后即成为该公司的虚拟特攻，更获试用新发明的防护机甲，不料遭遇神秘武装人员入侵，一场生死大战即将展开…

programme.title: 看不见的他们
programme.desc: 一场车祸后，林月家里怪事连连。全身冰冷的姐姐在镜子里看不见家人的身影，黑夜里爸爸窥探的双眼，和每天凌晨阁楼传来的弹珠声。林月循声而上去寻找真相，却在打开阁楼的门后，发现里面紧锁的是自己的遗像…

programme.title: 非法移民
programme.desc: 改编自真实个案，交织着年青偷渡客的友谊、爱情与理想的梦。青年张君秋偷渡纽约，一方面要筹钱还给偷渡集团，另一方面希望通过假结婚获得居留权，故不断找寻假结婚物件。

programme.title: 少年叶问之危机时刻
programme.desc: 1917年，少年叶问初到香港求学。英文演讲比赛当天，学校发生一宗惊天绑架案，全校同学都被挟持。面对眼前的危机，叶问挺身而出，发现绑匪竟然是自己的师父和好兄弟。少年叶问在危机时刻可否打败绑匪，从而伸张正义？

programme.title: 凌晨两点半2
programme.desc: 依成和朋友到聚魂灵山探险，传说山中埋着千年女尸，千年不灭之阴火，进去的人都逃不出来。凌晨两点半，依成的朋友先后突然消失。在森林搜索期间，依成进入无限轮回的灵异空间，更恐怖的事情却接踵而来…

programme.title: 零号追杀
programme.desc: 退出江湖的特工华叔，在老街以开古董店为生。一天，老街遭当地青龙帮强拆时，华叔隐藏的身份被暴露，并受到阿杰为首的神秘组织追杀，由此展开了一场双雄对决!

programme.title: 逃学威龙
programme.desc: 飞虎队精英周星星奉命潜入校园，调查一宗警枪失窃案。在拍档达叔的协助下，他不仅成功寻回失枪，更意外揭发一宗大型地下军火交易。走私集团为报复，悍然持械闯入学校，挟持多名学生作为人质。周星星必须不惜一切代价，拯救所有人质。

programme.title: 赌城大亨II 之至尊无敌
programme.desc: 本片是《赌城大亨之新哥传奇》的续集，讲述贺新用了20年时间，成功建立其赌业王国，但同伴却不甘屈居其下，于是设局争夺赌业控制权。另一方面，青年傅震为贺新旧情人的儿子，以为父亲被新所杀，便处心积虑安排报仇大计。胆识过人的贺新面对各样的威胁，绝不坐以待弊…

programme.title: 望夫成龙
programme.desc: 在乡间长大的情侣石金水和吴带娣青梅竹马，但娣父反对他们在一起，于是二人搬到市区共同生活。带娣为助金水找到一份推销员工作，暗中当舞小姐为其筹款。金水因工作勤奋，受上司赏识，加以提拔。虽然工作发展如意，但金水渐渐发觉自己与带娣的距离越来越远...

programme.title: 花心大少
programme.desc: 严钱声是一名自恃追女高手的富家花花公子，被母亲劝喻要成家立室。他在寻找生命中的女主角时，被两个追女高手挑战。到底他最后能否找到心中最爱?

programme.title: 混世四猴：神猴归来
programme.desc: 救世主灵明石猴曾赐予绝望女孩生存的希望，并许下守护终生的承诺。不料多年后，他与傲慢的三眼战神展开一场毁天灭地的大战，最终惨遭击败，金身碎裂堕入凡尘。失去神力的石猴，究竟能否重燃斗志，打破命运枷锁，再度归来履行当年对女孩许下的誓言？

programme.title: 西游记第壹百零壹回之月光宝盒
programme.desc: 逍遥山贼斧头帮帮主至尊宝，意外得知自己是孙悟空的转世。随着妖魔与仙界势力逼近，他被卷入月光宝盒引发的时空混乱之中。在爱恨纠葛与不可违抗宿命之间，他必须在凡人身份与救世重任中作出抉择。

programme.title: 表错七日情
programme.desc: 一对年轻夫妇因欠税款被法庭下令封屋，限七日缴付欠税，并以房屋和财产作为抵偿。丈夫因移情别恋不知去向，法庭则雇用一个年轻的护卫员来看管少妇。那护卫员竟然与少妇日久生情…

programme.title: 风云雄霸天下
programme.desc: 十年前，笃信命理的「天下会」霸主雄霸请来泥菩萨推算命运。泥菩萨预言，若想称霸武林，必须收两位名字分别带有「风」与「云」的少年为徒，他们将助他成就霸业，也将左右他一生的命运。霸业虽成，预言却骤然逆转，一场由批言引发的武林浩劫，彻底改变了整个武林的命运。

programme.title: 国产凌凌漆
programme.desc: 一名被重新启用的后备中国特工伪装成猪肉贩，意外被派去追回被盗的恐龙头骨。他被派往香港，并在一名暗中为反派效力的女特工协助下展开行动。两人在重重背叛与危机中应对挑战，最终对抗幕后黑手，成功夺回国宝并揭露阴谋。

programme.title: 僵尸先生
programme.desc: 茅山师父九叔受委托为富翁起棺迁葬，祈求新墓地能催财。惟富翁之尸体出现尸变后，变成僵尸，并在村内四处为害。此时，九叔的两名徒弟亦分别被僵尸所伤和受女鬼迷惑。九叔如何同时面对徒弟们生死存亡，以及僵尸为害的问题呢？

programme.title: 伤城
programme.desc: 屡破奇案的凶杀组总督察刘正熙的富豪岳父惨遭谋杀，刘正熙太太因对警方的调查进展产生怀疑，请来丈夫昔日的生死之交、私家侦探丘建邦调查真相。随着调查不断深入，案情峰回路转，丘建邦最终发现案件竟与刘正熙有着千丝万缕的关系。

programme.title: 火云邪神之修罗面具
programme.desc: 十八年前，邪恶的黑羽会潜入了老邪神西城勇的地盘，盗走了修罗面具，而利用修罗面具放出当时只是个婴儿的魔神。老邪神为了魔神日后不作恶收养了婴儿，教他好好做人，成为小邪神。小邪神最后控制了面具的力量成为老邪神的接班人，继续守护城市。

programme.title: 僵尸家族
programme.desc: 一群盗墓的考古学家意外发现一个保存完好的僵尸家族，计画将他们贩卖至黑市牟利。岂料在运送途中，不慎撕下封印僵尸的纸符，让沉睡的亡灵苏醒逃窜。然而，当地中医师林正英挺身而出，誓要将它们彻底剿灭。

programme.title: 武状元苏乞儿
programme.desc: 苏乞儿原为贵族，但因上京考武状元时作弊，被眨为乞儿。苏乞儿在机缘巧合下救了丐帮长老，并接任为新帮主。一天，皇上狩猎之时，差点被暗杀，幸苏乞儿及时救驾。皇帝欲恢复其官职时，苏乞儿却拒绝。其后，皇上御赐一个乞儿钵予苏乞儿，从此他过着愉快的行乞生活。

programme.title: 见怪
programme.desc: 失明的游己任在离岛的工厂工作。一天，因飓风的破坏，工厂与外界隔绝。此时突然有一只怪物来袭，任何看到怪物的人都会化成黑影。因游己任看不见怪物，他能成功协助伙伴安全离开，更奋战反击，誓要杀死怪物！

programme.title: 激战
programme.desc: 曾经叱咤世界拳坛的拳王程辉，在澳门遇见了热血青年思齐。随着他悉心训练思齐备战即将举行的混合格斗赛，两人在挑战极限的过程中共同成长。程辉不仅重燃了对拳击的热爱，也重新找回了对生命的热情，并学会珍惜生命中真正重要的人。

programme.title: 摩登仙履奇缘
programme.desc: 陈七是职业惯匪，偷呃拐骗无所不为，但从不使用暴力；张曼珠是电视台新晋演员，收入微薄，生活拮据。一次偶然中，陈得到了一枚巨钻，欲找买家脱手，却遇杀手追杀，情急下将巨钻藏于某鞋店的一只高跟鞋内，后来，此鞋刚好被张买去参加舞会……

programme.title: 裂战
programme.desc: 为了对抗温室效应，女科学家颜欣培育出超级橡胶种子，前往一个荒岛进行种植，希望将那里改变为一片欣欣向荣的新土地。然而，她的前夫决定在这趟危险的旅程中保护她，与她结伴同行。抵达后，他们面临接连不断的冲突，并遇上当地的贩毒组织，一场生死对决随即展开。

programme.title: 十万火急
programme.desc: 这是关于香港消防员的英勇救火故事。勇敢的消防员无惧冲天大火，肩负救灾扶危的重任，甚至舍身救人。但当消防员脱下制服后，是否仍同样勇敢地面对自身的难题呢？

programme.title: 逃学威龙 2
programme.desc: 周星星遭降职后愤而辞去警职，私自潜入一所国际学校，调查国际恐怖分子的阴谋。期间，他意外发现探员达叔正假扮成教师。两人随即联手，共同对抗全副武装的罪犯，展开一场终极对决。

programme.title: 宝贝计划
programme.desc: 城中著名的「盗贼三人组」受聘以3000万元绑架一名婴孩。当他们发现黑帮不仅企图吞掉赎金，更要置婴孩于死地后，决定担起保护婴孩的责任，并护送他平安回家。一方面要躲避警方追捕，另一方面又遭黑帮穷追不舍，三人即使危机四伏，仍誓死守护婴孩。

programme.title: 求爱敢死队
programme.desc: 失恋的王晶认识了电台节目主持曾志伟。志伟自诩情场杀手向王晶提供追求秘诀，但当其本身周旋于妻子与情人的关系当中，却不知如何是好...

programme.title: 七小福
programme.desc: 本片是改编自京剧大师于占元师傅的真实故事。六十年代戏剧文化日渐衰落，但于师傅仍坚持要保留他的戏剧学院。三个少年决意入读于师傅的戏剧研究学院，向他拜师学艺，经过艰辛的训练过程后，于师傅终于成功造就香港影坛这三大巨星。

programme.title: 扫毒2天地对决
programme.desc: 毒枭之首地藏与墨西哥毒贩联手扩张势力，令香港毒品世界陷入混乱。痛恨毒品的金融钜子余顺天悬红一亿歼灭毒贩，却与地藏有着不可告人的同门关系。随着两人的宿怨浮出水面，一场关乎生死与信念的终极浴血对决一触即发。

programme.title: 画魔人
programme.desc: 若为和两位闺蜜回到她儿时居住的房子，重遇一直住在那儿的表哥。他们本打算一起散散心，却频频遭遇灵异事件的侵袭，最后更变成一场惊心动魄之旅，有让人意想不到的结局。

programme.title: 千王斗千霸
programme.desc: 名震赌坛的千王与其拍档受命调查一位上海赌界大亨，怀疑其以赌场为掩护从事间谍活动。两人深入危机四伏的赌局世界，在层层布局与试探中步步为营，与强敌展开一场关乎生死与荣耀的斗智对决。

programme.title: 一个人的武林
programme.desc: 武术教头夏侯武因错手杀人沦为阶下囚，却在狱中敏锐察觉到一场针对全港武林高手的连环杀戮。他凭神准预判命案成功赢得女督察陆玄心的信任，破格出狱协助调查。与此同时，先天残疾却武痴成狂的封于修四处血腥挑战各路宗师。随着杀戮疯狂升级，两位绝世武者终将迎来轰烈对决。

programme.title: 僵尸叔叔
programme.desc: 偏僻山间，一僧一道比邻而居。和尚（午马 饰）随和开朗，更有一女徒菁菁（李丽珍 饰）玲珑可爱；道士（陈友 饰）古板严厉，而徒弟嘉乐（钱嘉乐 饰）却鬼马顽皮。性格不同的两个师傅口角不断，大斗其法，两个冤家徒弟也搞笑连连，笑料频出。

programme.title: 大上海
programme.desc: 黑帮头目成大器步步攀升至权力巅峰，却深陷两名女子的情感纠葛与特务机关的阴谋算计，并在战争逼近的威胁下挣扎求生。

programme.title: 我爱神仙遮
programme.desc: 推土车司机阿成，在工作时忽遇地陷而堕入一地下古庙，无意中成为油纸伞妖的主人。她更将自己现身的秘密及超凡的法力告知阿成。地盘工目凡叔嗜赌，欠下恶少高利贷，恶少垂涎凡叔之女美色，要凡叔以女还债；阿成得悉后请伞妖戏弄恶少，并暗助凡叔在赌场获胜，清还债项。惟此神伞之秘密却被恶少发现…

programme.title: 拳击小子
programme.desc: 以行船为生的前拳手提早退休，重回香港，遇上青年。青年因追求老板妹妹而与货运少东起冲突，并将少东打伤。他们约定三个月后双方擂台打拳以定强弱...

programme.title: 男与女
programme.desc: 偷渡客孟思晨匿居于山边木屋区，沦为众男工具，期间结识非法拳师江远生，并发生雾水情缘。后来思晨下嫁中年木匠贵叔，生活虽安稳，心灵却空虚。意外再遇远生后，难免干柴烈火，未几更有孕...

programme.title: 贼王之王
programme.desc: 两名私家侦探欲藉破一连环大劫案而声名大噪。岂料调查过程中竟一再被贼王使计愚弄，笑话连篇。及后更发现原来所有劫案均与日商宫本有关，到底谁才是真正的贼王之王？

programme.title: 青面修罗
programme.desc: 年轻刺客青面修罗接受人生首份刺杀任务，同时暗中调查当年自己家族灭门惨案幕后起因。但任务还未完成，他发现自己已经卷入了一场策划多年的阴谋当中，唯有利用自己的刺客技能，一一破局。

programme.title: 最佳女婿
programme.desc: 新潮发型屋少东 Happy 哥与死党赖布甸、龙眼仔, 因抢走上海理发店板大松客人, 与他发生口角. 一夜, 三人胡涂地与松女儿阿英醉宿一宵, 之后英意外怀孕, 不知是谁才是经手人, 惟有待孩子出世后, 以血型辨别亲父, 怎料三人皆属同一血型...

programme.title: 白蛇传说
programme.desc: 这部奇幻动作片改编自中国经典传说《白蛇传》，讲述郎中许仙爱上化身为女子的千年白蛇。白蛇的真实身份被揭露后，高僧法海为守护人类与超自然力量之间的平衡，不得不挺身而出，展开一场惊心动魄的对决。

programme.title: 叶问
programme.desc: 咏春大师叶问的功夫在中国各地备受推崇。正值日本侵华，叶问被迫离开家园并要找工作养家糊口。他唯有无奈地以咏春拳教导学生自卫训练，以赚取生活费用。

programme.title: 风流冤鬼
programme.desc: 红歌女阿花遭大户陶老爷奸杀，陶宅即常闹鬼，后陶老爷亦神秘死亡。陶之后人陶明嗜赌如命，更因鬼魂作怪而欠下钜款。明妻暗中将陶宅售予杨教授夫妇，即遇上怪事连篇...

programme.title: 靓足100分
programme.desc: 林天赐的富商祖父病重，欲将遗产留给他，但条件是天赐要在一个月内结婚，否则遗产将归祖父侄儿罗伯特。不久天赐邂逅乐小小，两人渐生情愫。罗伯特即派玛丽琳利用美人计破坏他俩的感情。不料玛丽琳贪图遗产，准备真的与林结婚。罗心有不甘，捣乱婚礼，并揭发她的计谋…

programme.title: 精武风云 - 陈真
programme.desc: 1920年代的上海，陈真以年轻实业家身份潜伏，欲揭露黑社会头目与日军的勾结。他不仅要取得头目的信任，还需应对日军将领麾下杀手的重重狙杀。为隐匿行迹，他戴起黑色面具，联手警局队长，以威猛铁拳守护这座城市的爱国志士。

programme.title: 画皮
programme.desc: 书生王怀卿卖画，为要筹药费救患重病的妻子，途中意外遇上雀妖的追击，幸得狐妖小容相救。为躲避雀妖，王怀卿将小容带回家中，三人随即陷入一场情感困局，而一段凄美的人妖虐恋亦随即展开。

programme.title: 卧虎藏龙
programme.desc: 剑侠李慕白将绝世宝剑「青冥剑」托付王爷府保管，岂料竟遭玉娇龙盗去。这位出身高贵却武艺超凡的玉娇龙，师从邪道「碧眼狐狸」。李慕白惜其才华，屡次欲导其向善而未果，二人终究难逃命运纠缠，注定共赴悲剧。

programme.title: 百变星君
programme.desc: 富家子李泽星挂名留学，实际上却挥金如土，并自命情圣，称霸校园。一日，因搭上黑帮老大情妇Silvia，而遭黑帮刺杀，被炸得粉身碎骨。这个财大气粗的李泽星以百变金刚之姿态复活，还掌握了独特的能力，得到一份真正的工作，还有他真心爱上的意中人。

programme.title: 黑白潜行
programme.desc: 香港警员阿山以卧底身份潜伏在监狱，接近罪犯天哥，以获取其犯罪集团的更多证据。二人获释后，阿山全力帮助天哥扶摇直上，最终使天哥成为集团的主脑。然而，当阿山协助警方顺利摧毁犯罪集团时，他却意外揭开了天哥的一个惊天秘密…

programme.title: 法中情
programme.desc: 摄影师田迪文强奸模特儿凌祖儿，幸得大律师叶颖文洗脱控罪。颖文男友高级督察方伟负责此案，不满女友是非不分。祖儿之妹凌珊珊替姐报仇，反遭田施暴，颖文再任其辩护律师。珊珊因过往不良纪录，处处失利，能够令田入罪的机会极微；检控官决定请师兄龙约翰出山相助。

programme.title: 靓女差馆
programme.desc: 雷女警长率领的港岛东刑事侦缉组的组员全是女警，因此有「靓女差馆」之称。警员生啤和沙爹对各女警一见难忘，遂主动申请调职到靓女差馆，意图接近众女并展开追求。这时，靓女差馆收到炸弹恐吓，她们最后能化解危机吗？

programme.title: 怪谈
programme.desc: 在迷雾村，为人养子的文杰反复梦见同一个噩梦。为了解开身世之谜，他卷入连串神秘的失踪案件中。随着更多村民相继离奇死去，村民更深信不疑千年来的井龙王诅咒。于是，文杰与保安队长联手探寻真相，揭开反派阴谋，最终拯救被危害的无辜村民.

programme.title: 除暴安良
programme.desc: 三名持枪劫匪抢劫了一批正在运送的新发行货币，刑警常勇奉命展开调查。随着线索逐渐浮现，常勇成功击毙一名劫匪。然而，其他两名劫匪不甘就此罢手，乘乱密谋抢劫金厂的黄金。常勇凭藉精密的部署，成功粉碎了他们的计划，将不法分子绳之以法。

programme.title: 替枪老豆
programme.desc: 万与夏婚后多年忽想生育，但万被证实不育，让夏接受人工受孕；但万心中仍感怪异，内心矛盾弄得精神紧张，行为乖张，闹出不少笑话；万在夏平安产子前后，屡有奇异幻想，误会连场，猜疑甚多，更怀疑夏与任职于夏威夷精子银行的表哥潘震伟有染，不是人工受孕，而是被人受孕。

programme.title: 多乐路
programme.desc: 东北某小城，一家麻辣汤馆每天都迎来不同的客人。这些客人中有如胶似漆的小情侣，两名放荡不羁的青年和一位的士司机。他们本是毫无交集的人，却因为一场交通事故牵扯在一起…

programme.title: 大内密探零零发
programme.desc: 零零发是宫廷四大高手之一，专职保卫皇帝的安全。虽然不谙武功，却有着不寻常的嗜好：打造超越时代的发明。皇上被掳后，他靠着自己的过人发明救驾。

programme.title: 南北妈打
programme.desc: 关德兴年青时与李消云相恋，遭母亲反对，只好和周申玉结婚。关的儿子关仁坚工作上认识了文文。申玉发现儿子追求的女友文文，竟是消云的女儿。两个妈打情敌又一次碰头，再斗个你死我活。

programme.title: 降龙大师：魔龙咒
programme.desc: 龙王被降龙大师封印了五百年，龙王之女为解除父亲的封印，不惜穿越时空，回到五百年前杀掉降龙大师。但她没想到五百年前的龙王与降龙大师竟是生死挚友…

programme.title: 蛊
programme.desc: 故事描述黄锦燊饰的督察查出女童被杀案的凶手，竟为其父艾飞；艾狱中求见黄，告知曾在某地邂逅一女子，获赠颈饰，自此，林突感有性无能之趋向，而其女忽嗜生肉，并数次有伤害林之意图，友人劝其赴巫婆处占算，巫婆算出其女系邪魔入体，必须以九寸钉钉在头上将其钉死，林即在此不可思议力量作崇之下，将亲女钉死；黄赴某地查探线索，并从神媒查出艾中了尸油降，唯神媒法力不足，不能查出谁为降头师，嘱黄往一百里外之古刹，览高僧温马达摩求助...

programme.title: 九品芝麻官
programme.desc: 包龙星起初为清朝九品候补知县《九品芝麻官》，号称青天的包拯后裔，却无包拯维护公义的精神，接受地方土豪的贿赂而诬害忠良，以至人人喊打。后来痛改前非，为一名含冤被判处死刑的女子申冤，历尽千辛万苦上燕京告御状，最后被封为八府巡按，在公堂辩论打败恶势力，告大白于天下。

programme.title: 赌城大亨之新哥传奇
programme.desc: 取材自澳门赌王何鸿燊的真人真事，讲述由1930至1960年代赌王努力打拼至事业高峰的故事。1941年日本入侵香港，年青大学生贺新逃离香港奔赴澳门。贺新起初在码头做苦力，凭着他的胆色过人、刻苦耐劳和聪明机智，最终登上澳门博彩业的第一把交椅。

programme.title: 新少林寺
programme.desc: 骄横军阀侯杰在惨遭亲信曹蛮残酷背叛、痛失至爱幼女后，心灰意冷下大彻大悟投身少林隐姓埋名。不料野心勃勃的叛将曹蛮紧随其后引兵屠城，使千年古刹少林危在旦夕。已皈依佛门的侯杰重拾昔日信念，在这场充满血色的因果轮回中，誓以血肉之躯筑起最后的救赎。

programme.title: 倒数回击
programme.desc: 天才拳击手徐佳阳为了替父亲还赌债在地下酒馆打黑拳时被举报，痛失奥运资格赛，陨落拳坛。十年后，铁血教练陈丽月决要助她实现父亲的遗愿，重回拳坛找回昔日的自己。当拳击的热血碰上责任时，曾经失落的拳击梦能否再度燃烧？

programme.title: 西游记大结局之仙履奇缘
programme.desc: 在月光宝盒引发的混乱之后，至尊宝被卷入时空之中，并逐渐觉醒为孙悟空的真实身份。在凡人情感与天命之间不断拉扯，他努力在对紫霞仙子的爱情与肩负的使命之间作出艰难抉择。

programme.title: 马永贞
programme.desc: 从山东逃难至上海的马永贞，因救了势力人士谭四而受到赏识，又从黑帮头子杨双手上夺取了他在上海的第一个地盘，从此平步青云。杨双与巡捕房勾结，谋害谭四并派人伏杀马永贞…

programme.title: 国产凌凌漆
programme.desc: 一名被重新启用的后备中国特工伪装成猪肉贩，意外被派去追回被盗的恐龙头骨。他被派往香港，并在一名暗中为反派效力的女特工协助下展开行动。两人在重重背叛与危机中应对挑战，最终对抗幕后黑手，成功夺回国宝并揭露阴谋。

programme.title: 龙虎武师
programme.desc: 香港动作电影向来以龙虎武师的真功夫蜚声国际。这部纪录片向过去所有的龙虎武师致敬，并用上超过两年时间梳理了海量的影像资料，更采访了无数动作特技演员分享拍摄时的辛酸事迹，当中包括著名武打巨星成龙、甄子丹及洪金宝。

programme.title: 表错七日情
programme.desc: 一对年轻夫妇因欠税款被法庭下令封屋，限七日缴付欠税，并以房屋和财产作为抵偿。丈夫因移情别恋不知去向，法庭则雇用一个年轻的护卫员来看管少妇。那护卫员竟然与少妇日久生情…

programme.title: 新宿事件
programme.desc: 偷渡到东京的铁头与一帮华人在当地艰难求生，并逐渐建立起一股黑帮新势力。当铁头取得居留权，决心退出江湖、展开新生活时，势力的急速扩张却引来各方势力围剿。面对警方大举扫黑，加上兄弟无情出卖，他最终被迫重返江湖。

programme.title: 青蛙王子
programme.desc: 此喜剧在夏威夷开始，富家子为人腼腆，追女乏术，好友充当其爱情顾问，带他四出泡妞，却碰得一鼻子灰，闹出连场笑话。

programme.title: 女人心
programme.desc: 有妇之夫孙子威与莉发展婚外情，其妻宝儿忍无可忍，决定离婚。分居后，宝儿认识一群独身但不甘寂寞的女人，经常聚会，各自各精彩！子威后来发觉自己最爱的依然是宝儿，二人决定复合。怎料在庆祝复合的晚会上，二人经过一场争吵，竟宣布第二度离异...

programme.desc: Destiny refuses to leave the house and says she "basically checked out of life". The extremely hoarded house has come to the attention of the homeowners, and they want the house cleaned up.

programme.desc: A distress call in a quiet English village leads police to a volatile Tinder romance, where a man's escalating jealousy puts a young mother and her child in grave danger.

programme.desc: When the supposed great-niece of Marilyn Monroe, Krystal Jean Baker, 13, is found dead beneath a bridge in Texas' Bayou Country, investigators are stumped.

programme.desc: When a young mother, Selonia Reed, 26, is found brutally murdered in her car, detectives turn over every rock in small-town Hammond, Louisiana, in search of her killer.

programme.desc: A look at some of the wildest courtroom moments. An accused stalker screams expletives at the judge; a shooting victim's mother cries for justice; an assistant prosecutor argues with the judge; and more.

programme.desc: 100,000 roaring motorcycles roll into the Lake of the Ozarks region for the seminal event of the season, and the Lake Ozark and Osage Beach Police Departments must team up with the State Troopers.

programme.desc: Susan Mauldin disappeared from her Florida home in the middle of a renovation. A trail of bank records and surveillance footage led detectives to dark family secrets—and a killer's twisted plan.

programme.desc: Dubbed 'the vampire killer,' teen Mathew Hardman thought that taking a life would make him immortal. His victim was an elderly neighbour. After stabbing her, he removed her heart and drank her blood.

programme.desc: Troubled teen Alyssa Bustamante was a self-styled 'bad girl' who said she wanted to know how it felt to kill. She gave in to this curiosity and murdered her nine-year-old neighbour Elizabeth Olten.

programme.title: Murder At The Motel (S1) - Tragedy In The Township Ep1
programme.desc: July 1, 2021, Falls Township, Pennsylvania. Falls Township Police are dispatched to the New Falls Motel after receiving a call about an unresponsive female.

programme.desc: 长州战火再起，李嶷率军死守城池，崔琳则献策反击。眼看战局逐渐逆转，一场突如其来的变故却再次打乱众人的部署。

programme.title: 金宵大厦2 第3集
programme.desc: 失踪的Maurice突然在金宵大厦出现，却失去全部记忆，令Ella既惊喜又陌生。大厦住客郭渺渺因意外毁容及行动不便，与母亲李淑芬靠社会同情和捐助生活。然而，淑芬阻止女儿康复的背后，似乎隐藏着私心。

programme.title: 奇食记2 第6集
programme.desc: 时间成就风味，传承延续匠心。从毛南族"三酸"、古法鱼露到哈尼豆豉与彝族跳菜，本集聚焦新老两代手艺人的接力，品味岁月酝酿出的珍贵滋味。

programme.title: 贵妇们的战争 第6集
programme.desc: 身世造假曝光后，纱英从人人艳羡的贵妇沦为社区笑柄，连瑠璃也越来越依赖九条。浅见家随后再起风波，纱英更从DNA鉴定中发现惊人事实：寄住家中的未久竟是丈夫的亲生女儿。【附中英文字幕】

programme.title: 天才冲冲冲 第240集
programme.desc: 「寓教于乐」的大型综艺节目, 节目单元不仅推陈出新, 在生活中更能与三五好友, 一同尝试节目中的各项游戏, 亲身体验节目中的各项乐趣。

programme.title: 金宵大厦2 第4集
programme.desc: 渺渺得知母亲的意图后离家出走，并在Maurice相助下脱险。经历现实打击后，她逐渐明白母亲一直在保护自己；淑芬也为过去的行为深感后悔。母女终于和好，厄运却再次降临。此时，一名神秘人物出现在寻找真相的Ella面前。

programme.title: 市井豪门 第565集
programme.desc: 一条街隔开两个世界。一边是努力生活有苦也有笑的市场人生，一边是勾心斗角有钱却战战兢兢的豪门日子。

programme.title: 乐游原 第28集
programme.desc: 崔琳再度潜入敌营刺探军情，身份险些败露。李嶷率兵前往接应，却不知敌人早已布下更大的陷阱，静待他们自投罗网。

programme.title: 综艺玩很大 第116集
programme.desc: 南投最终战出现压倒性局面！对手看不下去主动伸出援手，胜负却依旧迅速分晓，连吴宗宪也忍不住恨铁不成钢。

programme.title: 二十一天 第12集
programme.desc: 调查逐渐接近核心，幸存者不得不面对自己在绝境中作出的选择。叶萧继续拼凑关键线索，而罗百百货沉降事故背后的秘密，也随着众人的证词一步步接近真相。

programme.desc: At school, Bluey and her friends enjoy various games. Teacher Calypso keeps her charges on track with a wise word and a song... all except the mysterious Pretzel.

programme.desc: Mum, Dad and Bingo must complete both their classes to pass Swim School but pleasing strict Big Fish instructor Margaret (aka Bluey) is proving very difficult.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Dragon - EP 41
programme.desc: When Bluey needs some assistance drawing a dragon for a story she is working on, she asks her dad, Bandit, for help.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Bees - EP 29

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Juice Badge - EP 4

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Machu Picchu, Peru - EP 6

It accidentally gets a blast from Glitch's size ray and grows to gigantic proportions. Another Grimbot pulls a lever and the monster robot slips through the front hatch, tumbling towards the ruins below.

They take all sorts of transport to catch Rhodri, and he is always one step ahead. Until finally, they're on a raft across the sea and land right by Rhodri's front door.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Squirrel Babies - EP 8
programme.desc: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with, Hennie bounces around in new dance shoes, and Happy loves water as much as Roly loves potatoes!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Song of Peace - EP 7
programme.desc: Betty recalls the first time she pushed the red button, the Squirrels explore a range of emotions with Happy, Angry Bull tells a not-so-sleepy bedtime story, and the gerbils sing.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - The Continent of Africa - EP 4
programme.desc: Glitch takes Tala to the continent of Africa to help her with an Academy project. When the pair get lost, the Go Jetters need to crack the clues and find them in this huge continent.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - The Pool - EP 22
programme.desc: Packing for the pool, Bluey and Dad tease Mum about being so fussy with what to take. But when they arrive underprepared, they realise a little planning goes a long way.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Double Babysitter - EP 38
programme.desc: When Uncle Rad and Frisky accidentally turn up to babysit Bluey and Bingo on the same night, they have to work together to make Bluey feel better about babysitter putdowns.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Ghostbasket - Bluey special trilogy episode 1 - EP 48
programme.desc: Dad is pretending to be an estate agent selling the Grannies' house to Mum, but Janet and Rita do not want to move out. They try to disrupt the sale by ambushing Mum in the hallway, driving their car through the kitchen and introducing Ghostbasket - a ghastly haunted washing basket.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Surprise! - Bluey special trilogy episode 3 - EP 50
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo want dad to play two different games, so dad tries to play both at the same time. While also watching the race on TV.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Dino Treasure Hunt - EP 14
programme.desc: When a pterosaur destroys Jen's dino proximity machine, Andy goes on an adventure to retrieve the pieces. Along the way, he meets velociraptors, an Alamosaurus and some hungry Gorgosaurus.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Socks - EP 4
programme.desc: It's laundry day in Playtime Towers, and Bella and Lift have washed everyone's socks. All they need to do now is find the matching pairs!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Tadpole Badge - EP 9
programme.desc: Duggee has made a beautiful rock pool. The Squirrels spot the strangest things - dots with tails, wriggling around. What on earth are they? They are baby frogs - tadpoles!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Kite Badge - EP 8
programme.desc: It's a very windy day and the squirrels want to play outside. What can they do? Duggee knows - he's flying his kite. The Squirrels set about making their own kites to fly.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Treehouse Badge - EP 7
programme.desc: Duggee is cleaning the clubhouse so the squirrels take refuge in the treehouse, but it's getting a little bit cramped these days. Norrie has an idea - maybe they need to add an extension.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Harbin Ice City, China - EP 11
programme.desc: When Grim HQ's heating gets stuck on, Glitch looks for a cold place to land and cool down. Meanwhile, the Go Jetters enjoy the cool sights of Harbin Ice City in China. Every year sculptors at the festival create realistic models of world-famous landmarks from blocks of ice, and Lars is attempting to carve the Eiffel Tower. Suddenly the sculptures around them begin to melt. The team investigates why everything is heating up and discovers a red hot Grim HQ sat in the middle of the festival. If the

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Go Jet Academy: Hailstorm - EP 10
programme.desc: The Go Jetters join Ubercorn in the Go Jet Academy to try out a brand new click-on: the G.O. Vac, a super vacuum that can suck up bad weather. In order to put it to the test, Ubercorn creates a small hailstorm cloud inside the dome and Lars tries to suck it up with the G.O. Vac. However, Glitch appears and tries to show off his new 'Grim-o-Freeze' and zaps the cloud. Instead of disappearing, it grows in size and ferocity, breaking the roof with a smash.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Batucada - EP 8
programme.desc: While working on the Brazilian Railway, Thomas and Gabriela get ready for the Batucada carnival at the docks.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Alarm Cluck - EP 8
programme.desc: Duck keeps oversleeping, so Sarah decides he needs his own alarm clock.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Twang Ball - EP 9
programme.desc: Scarf Lady introduces Sarah and Duck to a new game involving knitted sporting equipment.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Football - EP 33
programme.desc: Stanley is called to help setup a football pitch so the children can play, although he must think on his feet when the weather turns, and the players start getting wet.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Bell - EP 32
programme.desc: The Town Hall clock is broken, it's lost its Ding Dong. It will take hours to fix, so Stanley asks noisy Fred if he will shout "DING DONG" when the big hand is pointing up.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I'm Not Even Scared of Nothing - EP 17
programme.desc: Werewolves, cobras, alligators, and commando dragons! The animals chat about all the things which absolutely do not make them scared.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S01 - It's time to go to the hairdressers - EP 17
programme.desc: JoJo learns how fun the hairdresser's can be when she goes with Gran Gran for a trim. After helping the hairdresser, JoJo also gets her own new style ready for Ezra's party!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Puppets - EP 29
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo teach Unicorse good manners so he can ask Mum on a date, but things go awry when Unicorse eats a tick.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Turtle Boy - EP 30
programme.desc: Bingo finds a toy turtle at the playground and wants to take him home, but Dad says it's not the right thing to do.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Onesies - EP 31
programme.desc: When mum's sister Brandy comes over for a visit, she brings the kids onesies as a present, which has an unexpected effect on Bingo.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Medicine Badge - EP 16
programme.desc: Duggee's not very well, he's lost his voice. The Squirrels want to make him feel better. Duggee tries to tell them that he needs some water but the Squirrels don't quite understand, so they ask all the other animals for advice. Does anyone have the answer?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Pizza Badge - EP 15
programme.desc: The Squirrels help Duggee try out his new outdoor pizza oven. Duggee makes the bases, then the Squirrels each put on all the toppings they like best. Some of their combinations are ... interesting!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Dancing Bug Badge - EP 13
programme.desc: When a dancing bug lands on Duggee's head, he can't stop dancing. The Squirrels see that it's a tiny hillbilly bug with a fiddle. And what's more, he's got a band with him - the Hillbilly Bug Band.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Bishop Rock Lighthouse, Isles of Scilly - EP 41
programme.desc: Glitch plunges the sea into darkness in a night-time adventure near the Isles of Scilly.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Banana - EP 5
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits Theatre, it's Banana revealing an astonishing secret about herself in the opera piece, I've Got a Secret.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Grapes - EP 4
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits Theatre, it's the spectacular acrobatic grapes working together to perform the most difficult structures to perfection.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Turnip of Terror - EP 8
programme.desc: Supertato and the Veggies are shocked when they meet a turnip in the deli counter.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Veggies Got to Dance - EP 9
programme.desc: Supertato and Evil Pea face each other in a dance-off so Supertato can rescue his friends.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Running Around in Circles - EP 99

Curse of the Ring ‐ Casper finds a ring in the ‘Secre

programme.title: RONDA RODA
programme.desc: Ronda Roda kali ini membawakan sisi yang lebih mendalam. Kita mulakan dengan segmen Borak Motorkar bersama Yazid. Kemudian, nantikan segmen terbaru Cerita Aku yang menampilkan Roduwan Rashid sebagai tetamu jemputan, dan kita tutup episod ini dengan sesi Borak Motorkar bersama Ash.

programme.title: PODCAST LAGENDA
programme.desc: Podcast Lagenda bersama hos Falyq Hikyle membawakan Linda Rafar. Rancangan bual bicara santai ini mengupas kisah perjalanan hidup dan kerjaya beliau—daripada detik permulaan, cabaran, kegagalan, sehinggalah kejayaan yang membentuk dirinya hari ini.

programme.title: Seribu Rindu
programme.desc: Damia memulakan kehidupan baru bersama Airel, namun perkahwinan mereka hambar kerana Airel masih teringatkan Sara. Sementara itu, Sara berusaha mendapatkan restu ayahnya untuk berkahwin dengan Irfan. Damia pula mengejar cita-cita sebagai model, manakala Airel semakin tertekan apabila mengetahui Sara sudah bertunang dengan Irfan.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Antasya koma. Syarfan membesarkan Isabella sendirian. Hana telah ditangkap polis. Antasya mengalami amnesia dan Syarfan berjaya menyakinkan bahwa dia adalah suaminya. Hidup mereka damai dan gembira. Najwan meluahkan isi hatinya kepada Syafinaz dan diterima seikhlas hati. Alia turut menerima Nazrin yang bersungguh mengambil hatinya.

programme.title: 11 Cinta Sebelum Kamu
programme.desc: Ray, bekas playboy, melamar tunangnya Khadeja. Namun ibunya, Dato' Shikin - seorang ibu tunggal dan peguam - menetapkan syarat unik untuk restu: Ray mesti meminta maaf secara peribadi kepada 11 bekas teman wanitanya, merakam momen itu dalam tempoh 30 hari

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Cergas dan cekap Aisyah menyediakan segala keperluan buat diri Iskandar sementara menanti kepulangan Iskandar. Iskandar juga tidak sabar untuk pulang ke kondo itu bertemu dengan Aisyah. Iskandar terpaksa pulang lewat pada malam itu disebabkan mesyuarat penting TG Holdings. Aisyah menanti sehingga tertidur di ruang tamu. Aisyah menyangkakan Iskandar telah pulang, dia segera membuka pintu dan sangkaannya salah apabila Rey meloloskan diri masuk ke dalam kondo itu. Aisyah dan Rey bergelut, pistol dan pisau berada di tangan Rey. Aisyah cedera dan ketakutan. Dia berlari menyembunyikan diri di dalam bilik dan sempat menghubungi Iskandar. Iskandar meninggalkan mesyuarat itu, dia bergegas pulang ke kondo dan mendapati Rey ada di situ. Rey nekad mahu membunuh Aisyah dan mahu Iskandar rasa kehilangan nyawa orang yang dia sayang. Satu tembakan dilepaskan. Iskandar dan Aisyah membuat laporan polis. Mujur Inspektor Jefri sempat datang selepas dihubungi oleh Iskandar. Rey di masukkan ke dalam penjara. Iskandar berjanji akan menjaga Aisyah dengan sebaiknya, Iskandar bersyukur akan hadirnya seorang isteri yang memiliki keperibadian yang suci. Begitu juga dengan Aisyah, meskipun ingatannya belum pulih dia dapat merasakan kebahagiaan itu menjadi miliknya bersama Iskandar. Sangkar hati di buka, Aisyah bukan lagi seorang isteri yang menumpang kasih dalam hati seorang lelaki bernama Iskandar.

Val sebaliknya bergelut untuk meyakinkan ibunya bahawa dia sihat, dan tidak mengalami sebarang masalah kewangan.

programme.desc: Kehidupan diteruskan apabila Tish bergelut untuk mengatasi perpisahan dengan Raffy, manakala Jay bersetuju untuk bersedia menenangkan ibunya. Val mengelak daripada pengambilan UX baharu, yang kebetulan adalah lelaki yang dia temui pada hujung minggu. programme.desc: Airel dan Damia hidup seperti orang asing apabila Airel masih tidak dapat melupakan Sara. Sementara itu, Sara dan Irfan selamat bernikah serta memulakan kehidupan bahagia sebagai suami isteri walaupun masih kekok. Airel semakin terdesak mahu mendapatkan semula Sara, manakala Dato Muiz menjemput Airel dan Damia makan malam bersama.

programme.title: Mariposa
programme.desc: Acha, pelajar baharu yang ceria dan penuh tekad, jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Iqbal, seorang pelajar pintar yang terkenal dengan sikapnya yang sangat dingin. Iqbal diibaratkan seperti seekor rama-rama Mariposa, setiap kali cuba didekati, dia pasti akan melarikan diri. Walaupun sering ditolak oleh Iqbal, Acha tetap enggan berputus asa, tanpa menyedari bahawa Iqbal sebenarnya sedang bergelut dengan tekanan berat daripada keluarganya.

programme.title: Congkak
programme.desc: Kisahnya bermula apabila Kazman serta isterinya Sufiah mengambil keputusan bercuti bersama dua anaknya, Lisa dan Ely di sebuah banglo di tepi tasik. Kazman sudah berjanji dengan seorang kawannya untuk membeli banglo tersebut sebagai persinggahan semasa bercuti. Pelbagai peristiwa pelik berlaku sepanjang perjalan mereka termasuk kehilangan telefon bimbitnya. Setibanya mereka di banglo tersebut, peristiwa yang semakin pelik turut terjadi. Sufiah cuba meyakinkan Kazman untuk keluar dari rumah tersebut tetapi tidak diendahkan. Kazman tetap berkeras untuk membeli rumah tersebut kerana sudah berjanji dengan kawannya. Sufiah sentiasa merasakan ada makhluk sedang memerhatikannya. Salah seorang anak mereka, Lisa setiap malam akan turun ke sebuah bilik gelap untuk bermain congkak dengan seseorang yang hanya boleh dilihat olehnya seorang. Sufiah yang tidak boleh bersabar dengan perkara itu telah membuang congkak tersebut ke dalam tasik. Lisa juga sentiasa bermain di tepi belukar di belakang rumah kerana kawannya tinggal di situ sehingga Kazman perasan Lisa bermain menghadap kubur lama. Pada malam keesokannya, Sufiah dikejutkan lagi dengan bunyi congkak tersebut dari bilik yang sama. Apabila Sufiah pergi melihat, dilihatnya seorang tua sedang bemain congkak tersebut. Semakin lama peristiwa yang berlaku semakin pelik dan menyeramkan sehingga pada malam ketiga kedua-dua anaknya telah hilang dan Sufiah didapati tidur di siling bilik. Pak Tua, penduduk paling lama di kampung itu telah pergi ke rumah tersebut untuk menyelamatkan keluarga Kazman dan mencari Ely dan Lisa. Apakah sejarah sebenar banglo tersebut dan dapatkan Sufiah diselamatkan serta berjayakah Ely dan Lisa ditemui semula.

programme.title: The Equalizer S2 EP18
programme.desc: Keazaman McCall untuk menangkap Mason Quinn, penjenayah yang bertanggungjawab atas kematian Bishop, membelok kepada obsesi berbahaya yang boleh menyebabkannya kehilangan segala-galanya.

Menggabungkan elemen dekorasi dan pengisian Islam, program ini membantu mewujudkan persekitaran yang lebih kondusif untuk beribadah dan menghayati nilai-nilai murni.

programme.title: Ustazah Biker
programme.desc: Airra seakan tidak dapat menerima hakikat yang Aqil sudah pergi meninggalkannya. Keluarga Aqil menghadiahkan motorsikal Aqil sebagai tanda kenang-kenangan. Semasa hayatnya, Aqil memang gemar menunggang motorsikal berkuasa tinggi. Dia sangat sayangkan motorsikal itu malah Airra pernah terasa hati kerana Aqil seolah lebih menyayangi motor itu dari dirinya. Airra menerima hadiah itu dengan sedih. 5 tahun berlalu, Ziyad hidup bersendirian dan banyak menghabiskan masanya dengan berfoya-foya. Pesanan aruah isterinya agar dia memberikan pelajaran agama buat Firas menjadikan Ziyad sedikit tertekan.

programme.title: Mr Millennium
programme.desc: Keriuhan suara orang kampung mencari Jamil dan Mastora membuatkan Jamil dan Mastora yang baru masuk semula ke zaman sebenar mereka terjaga. Mereka pandang sekeliling dan terpinga-pinga kerana tidak yakin apa yang mereka lalui tadi. Jamil tengok sekelilingnya hutan, dia tiba-tiba rasa gembira sebab dah kembali pada asal. Orang kampung menjumpai Jamil dan Mastora di hutan itu dan membawa mereka pulang. Malam itu di rumah Jamil, penduduk kampung datang ke rumah Jamil silih berganti. Mereka semua tercengang mendengar hebatnya berada di zaman moden dengan kecanggihan yang melampau seperti yang diceritakan oleh Jamil.

programme.desc: Mengisahkan Syadon, seorang pemuda yang mencintai Mala. Pada suatu hari, Syadon bertemu seorang gadis bernama Pari yang sedang mencari kekasihnya. Semakin hari, Pari semakin suntuk waktu yang Pari ada untuk mengahwini jejaka idamannya dan pulang ke dunia kayangan. Syadon bertanya siapakah Pari yang sebenarnya dan setelah diterangkan, dia sukar mempercayainya. Pari terpaksa membuktikan kata-katanya dengan menunaikan permintaan Syadon.

Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

programme.title: Karipap-Karipap Cinta
programme.desc: Ali bekerja sebagai jurufoto di syarikat penerbitan majalah jatuh hati kepada Sarah, seorang lulusan Universiti Al-Azhar. Ali panik apabila rakan serumahnya memberitahu keluarga Sarah ingin menjodohkannya dengan seorang ustaz. Untuk memenangi hati Sarah dan keluarganya, Ali terpaksa berbohong dengan mengatakan dia juga merupakan seorang graduan Universiti Al-Azhar. Dalam masa yang sama bos Ali, Dato' Razali Bunari cuba mendedahkan satu skandal yang turut melibatkan bapa Sarah.

programme.title: Sate
programme.desc: Milah ialah seorang peniaga sate dan kedai satenya terletak di hadapan bengkel kepunyaan Kadir yang suka melakukan eksperimen aneh. Kadir ingin menyertai Anugerah Saintis untuk memenangi hadiah utama dan sekaligus menyenangkan hidup Milah. Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dia lalui untuk mencipta mesin miliknya dan akhirnya Kadir berjaya menyiapkan mesin tersebut dan menyertai pertandingan itu.

programme.title: Perempuan
programme.desc: Nita merancang untuk menikahi teman lelakinya, Idris. Berasal dari keluarga yang kaya, Nita merasakan ibunya bersikap seperti seorang majikan kerana kesibukan kedua orang tuanya. Nita menagih kasih sayang kedua ibu bapanya. Ingin bertunang dengan Idris namun ibunya ingin menjodohkan Nita bersama anak Datuk Hamzah.

programme.title: Putera
programme.desc: Putera Hussein, pewaris takhta kerajaan Nusantara yang tidak mahu dijodohkan dengan sepupunya, Puteri Balkis. Ayahanda Putera Hussein memberi tempoh selama 30 hari kepadanya untuk mencari bakal isteri. Putera Hussein menyamar sebagai rakyat biasa dan bertemu dengan seorang gadis bernama Noraini. Mereka berdua jatuh cinta namun percintaan itu mendapat halangan keluarga Noraini.

programme.title: Soal Hati
programme.desc: Daniel ialah seorang lelaki playboy kaya yang mempunyai perniagaan yang berjaya. Dia mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Nurul Ain, seorang gadis kampung yang bekerja sebagai jurujual. Daniel berusaha untuk memikat Nurul Ain dengan berpura-pura menjadi seorang lelaki biasa bernama Ahmad namun akhirnya diketahui oleh Nurul Ain. Dapatkan Daniel memikat hati Nurul Ain kembali?

programme.title: Seri Dewi Malam
programme.desc: Cinta seorang isteri kepada suami yang sangat kuat membuatkannya ingin terus berjuang untuk hidup. Azri menemui jalan untuk berkomunikasi bersama isterinya, Seri yang jatuh koma. Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

programme.title: Lurah Dendam
programme.desc: Sekumpulan ahli payung terjun yang diketuai Kapten Hanafi dalam penerbangan untuk membuat penerjunan di Kuantan. Kapal terbang yang mereka naiki terlanggar seekor burung helang dan mengakibatkan pesawat itu bergegar. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.

programme.title: Perjanjian Syaitan
programme.desc: Tambun membunuh Tok Kadim, penghulu di sebuah kampung dan kemudiannya mengatakan bahawa Tok Kadim mati satu kemalangan. Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Sejak itulah Ribut berusaha untuk membalas dendam sehingga berlaku beberapa siri kematian yang penuh misteri.

programme.title: SPIRITWALKER

programme.title: THE WHISTLEBLOWER

programme.title: PICNIC

programme.title: LOVE CLINIQUE

programme.title: SWITCH
programme.desc: The life of a top star actor was turned upside down when he meets a taxi driver on Christmas Eve.

programme.title: SORI: VOICE FROM THE HEART
programme.desc: A father searching for his missing daughter finds a satellite that remembers sounds from across the world. Using his daughter's voice as a beacon, the satellite helps him track her down.

programme.title: NEW WORLD
programme.desc: An undercover cop spends eight years to infiltrate South Korea's largest crime organization. When the head of the organization is killed, he becomes torn between his loyalties.

programme.title: Global View
programme.desc: " Global View," curated by seasoned journalists, guides you to view the world with a global perspective—broadening your horizons, expanding your understanding of the news, and enriching your knowledge.

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: " Big Boys Club" is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friends—Bob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The "Other Dimension" segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Mystic Nine
programme.desc: " Mystic Nine" tells the story of Zhang Qishan (William Chan) and Wu Laogou (Joseph Zeng) joining forces with Huo Xiangu (Chen Yao) and the other members of the Nine Gates to embark on an adventure amidst renewed turmoil in Changsha. A mysterious disappearance of Unit 401 uncovers a shocking secret buried for a century. Life-or-death choices, brotherhood, sectarian duty, and national righteousness intertwine. The members of the Nine Gates use their blood and sacrifice to protect their homeland and overcome difficulties together.

programme.title: This City Never Sleeps & What's On Today
programme.desc: SLF International Group Chairman Kun Chi Sam (John Chiang) is an influential figure in Macao. This business tycoon arranges for his two sons, Kun Hao In (Julian Cheung) and Kun Hao Kuan (Ron Ng), to serve as Co-CEOs of the group, placing them on equal footing. Hao In always regards Hao Kuan as a thorn in his side. To dismantle the powerful syndicate of Hao Kuan and his wife Wong Suet Ying (Kelly Cheung), Hao In announces his marriage to Hong Kong prosecutor Hung Hoi Wan (Samantha Ko). Hoi Wan and Suet Ying both hail from R. Cino Outubro and were once buddies. However, Suet Ying became the other woman and snatched Hoi Wan's boyfriend as she wanted to marry into a wealthy family. Hao In intends to take advantage of Hoi Wan's hatred by turning it into some weapon to attack Hao Kuan and his wife. In a situation where every family member seems to be scheming, Hao Kuan adheres to righteous principles and boldly deals with Hao In's relentless maneuvers.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Who Heals the Healers?
programme.desc: Doctors have said "You're sick" countless times, but rarely have they heard it said to themselves. The news department's Fang Dongsheng team is out in force again, still searching for the "patient" who least resembles a patient—the doctor. They are usually quick, decisive, and accurate in their actions, accustomed to life and death, but when the roles are reversed, becoming patients or caregivers on the sickbed, they too experience avoidance and anxiety. The gods in the public eye are ultimately just ordinary people. How do doctors who save others save themselves? The new program, "Doctor, Are You Sick?", delves into the difficult reality of doctors' lives, examining their vulnerability and struggles, and revealing the most authentic, flesh-and-blood human stories behind the white coats.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils (2021)
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and *Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils* is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng (played by Yang Youning), the leader of the Beggars' Sect; Duan Yu (played by Bai Shu), the prince of Dali; and Xu Zhu (played by Zhang Tianyang), a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by "love."

Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?

Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors."

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.

programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: This City Never Sleeps
programme.desc: SLF International Group Chairman Kun Chi Sam (John Chiang) is an influential figure in Macao. This business tycoon arranges for his two sons, Kun Hao In (Julian Cheung) and Kun Hao Kuan (Ron Ng), to serve as Co-CEOs of the group, placing them on equal footing. Hao In always regards Hao Kuan as a thorn in his side. To dismantle the powerful syndicate of Hao Kuan and his wife Wong Suet Ying (Kelly Cheung), Hao In announces his marriage to Hong Kong prosecutor Hung Hoi Wan (Samantha Ko). Hoi Wan and Suet Ying both hail from R. Cino Outubro and were once buddies. However, Suet Ying became the other woman and snatched Hoi Wan's boyfriend as she wanted to marry into a wealthy family. Hao In intends to take advantage of Hoi Wan's hatred by turning it into some weapon to attack Hao Kuan and his wife. In a situation where every family member seems to be scheming, Hao Kuan adheres to righteous principles and boldly deals with Hao In's relentless maneuvers.

programme.title: Mystic Nine
programme.desc: " Mystic Nine" tells the story of Zhang Qishan (William Chan) and Wu Laogou (Joseph Zeng) joining forces with Huo Xiangu (Chen Yao) and the other members of the Nine Gates to embark on an adventure amidst renewed turmoil in Changsha. A mysterious disappearance of Unit 401 uncovers a shocking secret buried for a century. Life-or-death choices, brotherhood, sectarian duty, and national righteousness intertwine. The members of the Nine Gates use their blood and sacrifice to protect their homeland and overcome difficulties together.

programme.title: Who Heals the Healers?
programme.desc: Doctors have said "You're sick" countless times, but rarely have they heard it said to themselves. The news department's Fang Dongsheng team is out in force again, still searching for the "patient" who least resembles a patient—the doctor. They are usually quick, decisive, and accurate in their actions, accustomed to life and death, but when the roles are reversed, becoming patients or caregivers on the sickbed, they too experience avoidance and anxiety. The gods in the public eye are ultimately just ordinary people. How do doctors who save others save themselves? The new program, "Doctor, Are You Sick?", delves into the difficult reality of doctors' lives, examining their vulnerability and struggles, and revealing the most authentic, flesh-and-blood human stories behind the white coats.

programme.title: New Kung Fu Cult Master 2
programme.desc: In this sequel, Zhang Wu Ji successfully rescued the Six Major sects at Dadu. Nevertheless, the quest for the Dragon Sabre continues as Wu Ji and his three girlfriends set sail for Ice Fire Island. After a series of vicious fights, they finally unveil the secret behind the Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre.

programme.title: A Gilded Game
programme.desc: Ambitious finance student Gao lands an internship as his friend's family business prepares to go public in H.K. Under the mentorship of top analyst Zhang, his swift rise is soon undone by greed. After betraying Zhang for a rival, Gao puts his friend's company in jeopardy. To redeem himself, he must seek help from Zhang to stop a hostile takeover.

programme.title: Demi-Haunted
programme.desc: Wan Fei is a promising Chinese Opera singer who is secretly in love with a man named Jiang Hao Feng. She wants to sing for him on stage but dies mid-song in a tragic accident. Years later, Wan Fei's ghost returns, and finds that part of her spirit has been reincarnated in the form of Chor Bai, a young Chinese Opera singer. This finally allows Wan Fei to fulfill her wish…

programme.title: Tales from the Occult
programme.desc: The movie consists of three tales about the horrors lurking in dark corners of the city. A young pop star goes back into depression when spooky things happen in her new home; an online influencer performs live in a mall, but it ends up being a livestream of his death; the residents of a tenement building battle a mysterious figure in the stairwell.

programme.title: July Rhapsody
programme.desc: A 40-year-old high school teacher is in midlife crisis. His marriage is on the rocks and he is involved in a taboo romance with a female student who has a crush on him. Meanwhile, his wife is off to care for her dying ex-lover who shares a complicated history with the couple...

programme.title: Relentless Fury
programme.desc: Captain Lin Lang and his elite mercenary team are tasked with escorting a mysterious woman safely home. Bearing the highest bounty in dark web history, she draws assassins from across the globe. Among them is the notorious fugitive Ray. Now, Lin and his team must survive a deadly fight to complete their mission.

programme.title: Another Me
programme.desc: Constable Li Mao marries a rich girl but her parents disapprove of their marriage. One day, Li accidentally discovers that he looks exactly like the prince! While he aims to secure a high ranking position in the palace, the prince wants freedom, so they decide to switch identities. This however, got them both involved in the minister's conspiracy…

programme.title: American Girl
programme.desc: 13 year-old Fen is uprooted from LA and moves to Taipei in early 2003, when her mother is diagnosed with breast cancer. She struggles to adjust to her new life with a new school and long-separated father, and drifts away from her mother. When her younger sister is misdiagnosed with SARS, they finally open up to each other during quarantine.

programme.title: Shadow's Edge, The
programme.desc: A team of skilled thieves pulls off a massive billion-dollar heist while outsmarting the “Sky Eye” surveillance system, shocking the city. To stop the criminals before they strike again, Macau police enlist retired surveillance expert Wong Tak Chung to rebuild an elite tracking squad and hunt down the elusive mastermind behind the operation.

programme.title: Dead To Rights
programme.desc: During the 1937 Nanjing Massacre, civilians hiding in Ji Xiang Studio are forced to develop film for the Japanese army, only to uncover photographic evidence of its atrocities. Risking execution if discovered, they decide to preserve the negatives and expose the truth, determined to reveal the horrors of the massacre to the world.

programme.title: The Vanished Murderer
programme.desc: Set in Northern China in 1932, inmate Fu Yuan escapes from prison by digging a tunnel with a silver spoon. Inspector Song Dong Lu is assigned to investigate the case. Following letters sent by Fu, Song travels to Hong City to uncover the mystery behind her disappearance, facing deeper conspiracies along the way.

programme.title: The Goldfinger
programme.desc: Inspired by Hong Kong's biggest financial scandal in the 1980s, this is a rags to riches story about Ching Yat Yin who is chairman of a listed company. With Ching's wealth and influence on the rise, ICAC senior investigator Lau Kai Yuen is determined to investigate the case, even if it means spending 15 years in pursuit of the truth.

programme.title: Ghost Wedding
programme.desc: Photographer Zhi Cheng is entangled with a "woman in red", leading to the deaths of his relatives one by one. When the girl he likes, Si Tong, also dies mysteriously, Zhi Cheng vows to find out the truth but ends up revealing the secret of a "ghost marriage"...

programme.title: Return Of The Dead
programme.desc: A long-awaited horror sequel after Enchanted Shadow, this is about three asylum inmates telling their stories. In story one, a husband and wife discover they should be careful what they wish for. A naked female ghost seeks revenge from her watery grave in story two, and a dead prostitute returns as a ghost in the last tale.

programme.title: Five Tough Guys
programme.desc: A titular gang of misfits come together to protect a patriotic general from a scheming usurper. To this end, the unlikely heroes act as the general's escorts on a dangerous journey to a distant British consulate, beset by enemies and sinister Japanese interference along the way.

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: Hsu Lo is up against an evil black magic practitioner San Kan Mi, who wants to place a death spell on him and a love spell on his fiancée Wang Chu Ying. Fortunately, Wang's friends manage to find another veteran witch doctor to take on the evil San. This bone-chilling tale of good versus evil races to a heart-stopping ending.

programme.title: Crazy Nuts Of Kung Fu
programme.desc: A roadside bandit and a traveling gambler team up to make money from gambling. In a successful attempt to steal a huge amount of money from a warlord's home, they encounter revolutionists who seek their help to fund the reform campaign. Will the two help the revolutionists' cause with the stolen money?

programme.title: The Eunuch
programme.desc: A year before Lo Wei directed Bruce Lee in Fist Of Fury, he wrote and co-starred in this tale of a treacherous devil who wants nothing less than supreme power...and doesn't care if he has to murder the Emperor and use his own daughter as a deadly dupe to get it.

programme.title: The Deadly Breaking Sword
programme.desc: Warrior Tuan Chang Qing meets courtesan Liu Yin Xi in a small town. Liu pleads Tuan to kill the underworld master Guo Tian Sheng, known as the "Killer Doctor", in order to avenge the death of her fiance. Tuan and gambling addict Xiao Dao breaks into Guo's household, triggering the battle of good against evil.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiao's stepmother frames her fiancé Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to 'him'. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan…

programme.title: The Singing Thief
programme.desc: A master jewel thief turns over a new leaf as a professional singer in a nightclub. However, a series of robberies happened shortly after and he becomes the suspect again. The thief then sets up a trap to snare the copycat but will this backfire on him?

programme.title: The Tiger and the Widow
programme.desc: The Liu Chia-liang trained Hui Ying-hung was considered the top action martial arts female star in the 1980s. It is her martial arts abilities that Michelle Yeoh tries to emulate. In The Tiger and the Widow, Hui Ying-hung is somehow mixed up in a salt smuggling ring that stinks of missing persons and rotten dilemmas.

programme.title: Six Assassins
programme.desc: Lord Li Ming is a feudal tyrant who oppresses the people, and even the Emperor who is his brother, cannot stop his evil act. Righteous swordsman Mu poses as Li Ming's guard to plan for his assassination. He arrests six assassins who have tried to kill Li Ming, before making them his allies in a secret plot to kill him and end the tyranny.

programme.title: A Maid From Heaven
programme.desc: The seventh daughter of the Jade Emperor is banished from heaven to live a mortal life as she is very mischievous. She falls in love with a young village lad Yong, who sold himself to work for the rich so as to bury his father. The goddess sisters help Yong to pay his debt so the lovebirds can be together. Is this going to end happily-ever-after?

programme.title: Dragon Swamp
programme.desc: Fan is cheated by her lover Tong to steal her master's Jade Dragon Sword. She is jailed in the Dragon Swamp as punishment and gave birth to a pair of twins - her daughter is raised by her master, while her son is taken by Tong. Twenty years later, the sword is stolen again and Fan's daughter goes seeking for it, meeting Fan's friend along the way.

programme.title: Sunset
programme.desc: Teenage heart-throbs Ching Li and Paul Chin Pei come across like Annette Funicello and Frankie Avalon in the musical Sunset, a musical romp that plays similar to one of Hollywood's famous "Beach Party" movies. A car load of girls meets a car load of boys, and Ching and Paul ultimately fall in love. Yet the film takes an acrid twist and turns out to be more like a Shakespearian tragedy than a beach-babe party.

programme.title: The Flying Dagger
programme.desc: The Yu family and the Green Dragon clan became enemies when the Yu daughter killed the clan head's son, who was a rapist and murderer. The Green Dragon leader wounds the head of the Yu family with his flying daggers, and a wandering swordsman saves the family using his own flying dagger skills. However, his allegiances and motives are unclear.

programme.title: Whose Baby is in the Classroom?
programme.desc: Chen, a male teacher in an all girls' high school, is stuck with a baby that isn't his and must take care of it. As he lives on the school grounds, the baby is a source of constant distraction and worry! Luckily, his class warms to the baby and helps him take care of it while he works his charm on Li Ching, an uptight teacher in the same school.

programme.title: UFC Fight Night: Allen vs. Duncan - Main
programme.desc: Middleweights man the marquee as UFC returns to the Meta APEX in Las Vegas on Sunday, October 11 as Brendan “All-In” Allen squares off with “CLD” Christian Leroy Duncan. A rankings staple for the last several years, Allen has forced his way into the Top 5 on the strength of a three-fight winning streak over Marvin Vettori, Reinier de Ridder, and Edmen Shahbazyan. Gloucester, England's Duncan has claimed five straight victories heading into his first UFC main event assignment, most recently out-hustling former title challenger Jared Cannonier in July.

programme.title: LALIGA LEGENDS - PEP GUARDIOLA
programme.desc: More than a title-winning machine, Pep Guardiola changed the face of football. Trace the evolution of his famed “tiki-taka” style of play that propelled the likes of Messi, Xavi, Iniesta and Busquets to footballing royalty.

programme.title: UFC 332: Silva vs. Wang - Main
programme.desc: UFC returns to Delta Center in Salt Lake City, Utah for UFC 332 headlined by a clash for the vacant UFC women's flyweight title between Natalia Silva and “The Joker” Wang Cong. The No.1 contender Silva enters having won each of her first eight UFC appearances and 14 consecutive contests overall, a run that includes victories over top contender Jasmine Jasudavicius and former UFC champions Jessica Andrade, Alexa Grasso, and Rose Namajunas. Fighting out of Liaoning Province, China, Wang arrives having won four straight and five of six appearances inside the Octagon, most recently defeating Tracy Cortez at UFC 329.

programme.title: UFC Countdown - UFC 314: Volkanovski vs Lopes
programme.desc: UFC 314 previews the promotion's return to Miami, where former featherweight king Alexander Volkanovski squares off against Diego Lopes for the vacant featherweight crown. Plus, lightweights collide as Michael Chandler takes on Paddy Pimblett.

programme.title: LALIGA LEGENDS - PEP GUARDIOLA

programme.title: Mencari Ramli Musim Ke - 4 - 11
programme.desc: Program pencarian bakat bola sepak yang hebat diteruskan lagi dengan Musim Ke-4. Program ini mencungkil bakat bola sepak anak-anak muda berusia bawah 14 tahun dan bawah 16 tahun.

programme.title: Sensasi Bola - 29
programme.desc: Sensasi Bola merupakan satu program bual bicara berdurasi setengah jam bersama pemain bola sepak, selebriti, jurulatih dan peminat sebagai tetamu undangan setiap minggu. Antara topik menarik yang akan dikupas adalah isu mengenai bola sepak tempatan dan antarabangsa, temubual ekslusif bersama lagenda bola sepak, tips kesihatan serta isu semasa yang menjadi perbualan masa kini.

Argentinian Ailin Perez opens up about her fierce drive for competition in the UFC Women's Bantamweight Division. Ode Osbourne participates in a youth mentorship program, where he delivers an impactful message to the SASA Squad Foundation.

programme.desc: Ray, seorang pemilik konglomerat berusia 60 tahun yang kaya-raya tetapi kesepian, kini sakit tenat dan terlantar di hospital menanti ajal. Semasa berada di ambang maut, seorang lelaki misteri berwajah samar muncul lalu membawanya mengembara secara spiritual ke masa lampau. Sambil mengimbau kembali detik kejayaan serta kedukaan pada zaman mudanya, Ray cuba mencari jawapan kepada lima persoalan besar tentang kehidupan, takdir, dan keadilan yang selama ini sering dipersoalkannya kepada Tuhan.

Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

Selepas berubah menjadi pontianak, dia menghantui penduduk kampung bukan untuk menghisap darah, tetapi mencari makanan sehingga berat badannya menjadi 100kg. Penduduk kampung cuba mencari cara untuk menghentikan gangguan tersebu

programme.title: #BerhentiDiKamu
programme.desc: Dr. Gia percaya Elsa ialah jodohnya selepas berdoa di Kaabah, namun selepas cintanya ditolak, dia bertemu Syafira yang juga sedang kecewa, lalu kedua-duanya menemui semula makna cinta, takdir dan kehidupan.

programme.title: Dunia Baru The Movie
programme.desc: Filem ini bermula apabila Opie menemui sepucuk surat daripada Anizah yang menyatakan bahawa dia ingin berkahwin dengan teman lelakinya, Fazley, dan telah menguburkan impiannya untuk menyambung pelajaran ke UK.

programme.title: Gol & Gincu
programme.desc: Kisah Putri yang cuba memenangi semula hati teman lelakinya dengan menyertai pertandingan futsal wanita bersama rakan-rakannya. Sepanjang perjalanan itu, mereka belajar tentang persahabatan, keyakinan diri dan makna sebenar cinta.

programme.title: Gol & Gincu 2
programme.desc: Sekuel kepada Gol & Gincu yang mengikuti kehidupan Putri dan rakan-rakannya selepas beberapa tahun. Mereka menghadapi cabaran baharu dalam kerjaya, cinta dan persahabatan, sambil cuba mengekalkan hubungan rapat yang telah lama terjalin.

programme.title: One, Two, Trivia
programme.desc: Sebuah program yang merungkai fakta-fakta menarik yang tersimpan dalam filem-filem klasik tempatan

programme.title: Sejoli
programme.desc: Jo (Bront Palarae) dan Gina (Maya Karin) sedang menyembuhkan hati yang terluka di Phuket apabila takdir mempertemukan mereka. Pada mulanya mereka saling membenci, tetapi apabila mereka mendapat tahu bahawa bekas kekasih masing-masing, Hardy (Remy Ishak) dan Nita (Izara Aishah), akan berkahwin, mereka merancang untuk menggagalkan majlis perkahwinan tersebut.

programme.title: Lebuhraya Ke Neraka

programme.title: Assalamualaikum Beijing
